u0: Normal monitoring state: the pot has no unresolved boil that still needs attention. Continue other shop work while watching for pot_boiling; when a boil starts, the machine moves to u1 and the active task becomes turning the stove down. Returning here after stove_fixed means the current boil is resolved, and the agent should remain alert for the next one.

If carrying food, first drop it on an empty cell and retrieve it only after the stove is down. Stay focused on this task until stove_fixed succeeds; then the machine returns to u0.
